Above Pull request Template is a generic way to handle most cases .



Steps to include PR template in your repository in Github

 

 

1. create a directory name .github/ in your Repository 

 

Open Screenshot 2025-01-07 at 4.44.35 PM.png

 

2. create a file named  pull_request_template.md  

create Markedown file with your Content similar as above code snippet 

and merge the changes to your main branch where you want the PR template to be used.

Once that is merged next time you raise PR with that base branch your template will be loaded.



Open Screenshot 2025-01-07 at 4.49.25 PM.png
